run_main: run the main function to start the HalfCheetahBulletEnv simulation with the pre-trained reactive policy
create_SmallReactivePolicy: create a SmallReactivePolicy instance with observation and action spaces to evaluate actions via the act method
test_SmallReactivePolicy_act: test the SmallReactivePolicy act method by passing an observation and receiving computed action outputs
review_SmallReactivePolicy: review the SmallReactivePolicy class to understand the multi-layer perceptron forward pass with ReLU activations
